description.value: The Stó:lō Gift Shop is a 100% Indigenous-owned retail store located on the historic Coqualeetza grounds at Stó:lō Nation in Chilliwack. It carries an extensive selection of authentic Aboriginal arts, crafts, and giftware from local artists and suppliers across British Columbia, including hand-carved silver jewellery, traditional medicines, drums, and Coast Salish-designed apparel. A stop here offers touring cyclists a meaningful cultural experience and the chance to support Indigenous artisans directly.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, open gift shop at 7201 Vedder Rd, Chilliwack (on the Coqualeetza grounds), operating Monday–Friday. The phone number 604-824-2670 appears in the FAQs subpage. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so all required criteria and optional amenities remain null. The OSM record had no address or phone, so the website is the authoritative source for both.
concerns: OSM record had no address or phone; both sourced from website only. Address confirmed as 7201 Vedder Rd, Chilliwack on the Coqualeetza grounds. Phone 604-824-2670 found in FAQs subpage but not cross-confirmed against OSM. OSM community is listed as Sardis, but the website address is Chilliwack — these are adjacent communities and the Coqualeetza site straddles the boundary, so this is not a significant discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, publicly accessible Indigenous gift shop at a confirmed physical address — a culturally notable stop for touring cyclists in the Chilliwack area.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website notes a temporary closure July 6–10 2026, reopening July 13. No cycling-specific amenities confirmed from website content.

wow_evidence: Indigenous-owned shop of authentic Stó:lō and BC First Nations art on the Coqualeetza grounds — distinctive walk-in stop.
blurb: Stó:lō-owned shop of authentic Coast Salish art and giftware.
